method: Actual sequential bilingual reading; mechanical checks do not substitute for prose review.

checks.summary: Read §5.1 ten-step conjugacy proof and Corollaries5.2–5.4 with proofs. Checked semilocal reductions, Galois action, A2 matrices, finite-field case splits, quantifiers and transverse/osculating distinctions, native diagram and editor footnotes. Translation faithful; no proposed correction.

Read Corollary5.5 four parts/proof, definitions and Corollaries5.6–5.11, nonabelian cohomology twisting proof and cartesian diagram, §6.1–6.6 proofs and start6.7. Checked least/minimal type, connected/isotrivial qualifiers, split-torus character modules, all quantifiers. Known 5.5 and5.11 opposite-pair source wording preserved, Chinese faithful.

Read end6.7, Proposition6.8 proof, all §6.9–6.18 statements/proofs, §7 opening through7.4 statement and start7.4.1. Checked critical/anistropic/isotrivial notions, noncentral split tori vs arbitrary nontrivial tori, Levi correspondence and order reversal, maximal/minimal, every iff and group equality, existing marked bar-k correction7.1.1. No proposed change.

Read §7.4.1–7.4.5 reflection/coroot construction proof, based relative root datum7.5, parabolic classification7.6–7.9, Bruhat relative position7.10 and beginning counterexample7.11. Checked integral vs rational multiples, reflection conjugacy, every existence/uniqueness, simple transitivity and subset inclusions. Chinese faithful. Source7.4.1 uniqueness ignores identity unless nontriviality implicit;7.4.5 cites7.3 for stabilizer while7.2 states torsor—record source semantics, do not rewrite.

Read counterexample7.11 ending, §7.12 base-change argument and inclusion diagram, full Theorem7.13 four properties, Remark7.14, Henselian lifting7.15 and all five bibliography entries/footnote. Checked base-change inclusions, canonical maps/surjectivity, existential Weyl lift, removal of zero, relative-type inverse-image formula and both reductions in7.15. No confirmed mistranslation and no proposals.
